headline: Nevish Line Seethes as Colonials Reach Third Post; Marban Hollow Stirs
war_summary: Since our last edition the Nevish Line has grown hotter still: Colonial flags now stand at three of its eight strongpoints against five Warden posts, seventy-four flag actions are logged in a day, and Blackcoat Way, Grief Mother and Princefal bear the brunt, with two-hour losses past eight hundred a side and climbing. Stlican Shelf, silent in our last edition, has flared anew — flag movements recorded at the very hour of this dispatch and two-hour losses above a thousand — while Marban Hollow, long still, shows fresh fighting at Checkpoint Bua, its eight grounds split three Warden, three Colonial, two in ruin. In the Weathered Expanse the Warden grip holds at six posts against one, the earlier flood of casualties cooling to a trickle, though Crow's Nest remains the busiest ground. Linn Mercy's casualty rolls shrink by the hour, its flags last moving shortly before one o'clock, Lathair the focal point; Kuura Strand has been quiet six hours, five Colonial posts and one ruin standing. Elsewhere the maps are largely still, though Callahans Passage rolls up heavy losses without a flag turning. It is day 706; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize and no victor is declared.
